questions.title: Comprehensive Contract Testing Strategy
questions.question: Design a comprehensive contract testing strategy for a microservices e-commerce platform with 15 services (order service, payment service, inventory service, shipping service, notification service, etc.). The platform uses: REST APIs for synchronous communication, Kafka for event streaming, webhooks for third-party integrations, and gRPC for internal high-performance communication. Address: 1) Contract testing approach for each communication type (REST, Kafka, webhooks, gRPC), 2) Team organization and responsibilities (who writes consumer contracts, who verifies), 3) Pact Broker setup and contract sharing workflow, 4) CI/CD pipeline integration (when to run consumer tests, provider verification, can-i-deploy checks), 5) Versioning strategy and handling breaking changes, 6) Provider state management for complex scenarios, 7) Testing external third-party APIs (payment gateways, shipping providers), 8) Contract evolution process (adding new fields, deprecating old ones), 9) Monitoring and alerting for contract violations, 10) Rollback strategy when contracts are broken. Include sample contracts, pipeline configurations, and team workflow diagrams.
questions.realWorldScenario: Building robust contract testing for complex microservices ecosystem
